$comment: Game clock and weather schedule of 01-engine-save-modes.md 'Time-of-day and weather clock' (M02b2). Design values: the owner may tune them. 172,800 half-seconds make one game day (7,200 per hour, 120 per minute); at rate 1 the clock advances 30 game seconds per real second. Weights are integers; hourBias multiplies a preset's weight when the change arrives inside [fromHour, toHour). The night and dark tables are piecewise-linear in the hour of day: [hour, value] pairs from 0 to 24 with equal ends.
